[DECISION_RULE]
Precedence is strict: INVALID_OBSERVER > HARD FAIL > INSUFFICIENT_DATA > AGGREGATE GATE.
INVALID_OBSERVER if observer/source identity/reflection contract fails.
HARD FAIL if decode status, accepted/rejected, canonical validity, or non-finite mismatch exists; sample completeness cannot mask it.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA only when no hard invariant failed and completed<60 or canonicalComparable<40.
Each candidate passes only if no hard invariant failed, sample completeness passes, and every fixed canonical aggregate gate passes against REFERENCE.
same-tensor backend PASS plus cross-tensor FAIL => PREPROCESSING_CONFIRMED.
same-tensor backend FAIL plus cross-tensor PASS => BACKEND_CONFIRMED.
both stage groups FAIL => BOTH_CONTRIBUTE.
REF_GPU vs B_GPU PASS with B_CPU-only failure and every non-B-CPU comparison PASS => MODE2_GPU_PASS.
Raw 478-landmark/bbox/centroid style proxy metrics are diagnostic-only and cannot fail the candidate alone.
Do not change thresholds after observing this run.
